steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Coordinates: Pairs of numbers (x, y) that specify a position on a grid. The x-coordinate comes first, then y. | Remember: "Along the corridor, up the stairs" - x first, then y.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: In which quadrant is the point (-4, 3)? | What are the coordinates of a point 3 units right of (-2, 5)? | Find the midpoint of (4, 2) and (10, 8).
